summary: Deploy died on `get stack failed: HTTP 403` for stack shortawning2091, which was read as "the stack lives in another org" and fixed by switching the slug to the <namespace> slug. The real cause was GRAFANA_CLOUD_API_TOKEN's access policy lacking stacks:read/stacks:write: shortawning2091 is the org's own (and, on the free plan, only) stack, and creating the <namespace> stack failed with 403 at the plan limit. Fixed by granting the stacks scopes and adopting shortawning2091 as the shared stack (libs/infra-shared-ts/tofu/global.tfvars.json).
